scripts.name: The Game Boy Horror
scripts.description: The Game Boy Horror demos: the handheld's own vignette (gameboy.szp) and the seven scene clips of gbdemo01..07, which share one model with seven .key animations. The screen's texture-pattern flipbook (.txp) is not yet decoded, so the display holds its rest frame.
